text: Mbah, look at my lantern! The shards from Temanggung are glowing inside it. Magelang will be easy!
asr: Umbe, look at my lantern. The shards from Tumangong are glowing inside it. Margellang will be easy.

text: Don't feel too sure of yourself, my boy. The mist in Magelang has other tricks.
asr: Don't feel too sure of yourself, my boy. The Mist and Magalon has other tricks.

text: What tricks, Mbah? That's Borobudur Temple, isn't it? It's magnificent... But why do the reliefs look strange?
asr: What tricks on bar? That's Barabou-dour Temple, isn't it? It's magnificent. But why do the reliefs look strange?

text: The Mist of Forgetting has jumbled their order. The beginning of the story is at the end, and the end is in the middle. Anyone who reads them now only gets confusing bits and pieces.
asr: The mist of forgetting has jumbled their order. The beginning of the story is at the end, and the end is in the middle. Anyone who reads them now only gets confusing bits and pieces.

text: Mbah, listen... Down there, two men are arguing.
asr: Umbar, listen. Down there two men are arguing.

text: One shouts, "They say this temple was built in a single night!" The other shouts back, "They say it's all just a fairy tale!" Both are loud, but neither of them wants to check.
asr: One shouts, they say this temple was built in a single night, the other shouts back, they say it's all just a fairy tale, both are loud, but neither of them wants to check.

text: So which one is right, Mbah?
asr: So which one is right and bar?

text: That is your task, my boy. Opinions may differ, but facts can be proven. Connect one piece of information with another, and the truth will appear.
asr: That is your task, my boy. Appendian's may differ, but facts can be proven. Connect one piece of information with another, and the truth will appear.

text: Ohh... Forgive me, my boy. My legs are shaking. Every time the mist grows thicker, it feels like my strength is being drained away.
asr: Oh, forgive me, my boy. My legs are shaking. Every time the mist grows thicker, it feels like my strength is being drained away.

text: Mbah! Are you all right? Your hands are so cold!
asr: Mbar, are you alright? Your hands are so cold.

text: Don't worry... I just need to sit for a while. The lantern's light and this old body are bound together, my boy. The more shards return, the stronger I become.
asr: Don't worry. I just need to sit for a while. The lanterns light in this old body are bound together, my boy. The more shards return, the stronger I become.

text: Then rest here, Mbah. Let me put those stories back together.
asr: Then rest here on bar. Let me put those stories back together.

text: You are not the same child who once ran towards a signpost without reading it.
asr: You are not the same child who once ran towards a signpost without reading it.

text: Because I learned from you, Mbah. Read carefully first, then act!
asr: Because I learned from you on bar. Read carefully first then act.

text: Remember my advice: find the main idea, put things in order, and separate facts from opinions. Four shards of Magelang are waiting for you.
asr: Remember my advice, find the main idea, put things in order, and separate facts from opinions. Four shards of Mogulong are waiting for you.

text: I'm off, Mbah. Before dusk, those reliefs will tell their stories the right way again!
asr: I'm off, unbar. Before dusk, those reliefs will tell their stories the right way again.

text: We're here, my boy. Temanggung... From this hill, the village lights used to look like stars that had fallen onto the fields. Now look. Everything is grey.
asr: We're here, my boy. Timondun. From the sill, the village lights used to look like stars that had fallen onto the fields. Now look. Everything is gray.

text: The mist is so thick, Mbah. I can hardly see the path in front of us.
asr: The mist is so thick umbar. I can hardly see the path in front of us.

text: The Mist of Forgetting came here first. Do you hear that? People are calling to each other across the fields. They are lost in their own village.
asr: The mist of forgetting came here first. Do you hear that? People are calling to each other across the fields. They are lost in their own village.

text: Lost? How, Mbah? Isn't there a signpost at every crossroads?
asr: Lost? How unbar? Isn't there a signpost at every crossroads?

text: There is. But the mist makes the writing faint. People only glance at it, then guess the way. One wrong guess, and they wander in circles through the fields until dusk.
asr: Varys, but the mist makes the writing faint. People only glance at it, then guess the way. One wrong guess, and they wander and circle through the fields until dusk.

text: Then we have to hurry, Mbah! I'll just go straight for the shards. Something must be shining behind the mist!
asr: Then we have to hurry, umbar. I'll just go straight for the shards. Something must be shining behind the mist.

text: Look, a signpost! The arrow points right... Come on, Mbah, this way!
asr: Look, a signpost. The arrow points right. Come on, on bar, this way.

text: Wait, my boy! Stop! Don't just look at the arrow. Read all the words first.
asr: Wait, my boy. Stop. Don't just look at the arrow. Read all the words first.

text: "Bridge broken. Please go left." Oh no... If I had run to the right, we could have fallen into the river.
asr: Bridge broken. Please go left, oh no. If I had run to the right, we could have fallen into the river.

text: There, you see. Hurried eyes miss answers that are written clearly. The Mist of Forgetting loves an impatient child most of all.
asr: There, you see. Hurry dies miss answers that are written clearly. The mist of forgetting loves an impatient child most of all.

text: I'm sorry, Mbah. I just wanted to help everyone as fast as I could.
asr: I'm sorry, umbar. I just wanted to help everyone as fast as I could.

text: Your heart is in the right place, my boy. But helping also takes care. Look, as soon as you read it properly, the mist on that sign grew thinner. Behind the hill, the first shard of light is starting to sparkle.
asr: Your heart is in the right place, my boy. But helping also takes care. Look, as soon as you read it properly, the mist on that sign grew thinner. Behind the hill, the first shard of light is starting to sparkle.

text: I understand now. I will read word by word, look at pictures closely, and listen carefully.
asr: I understand now. I will read word by word, look at pictures closely and listen carefully.

text: Four shards are waiting for you in Temanggung. Find the information that is clearly written, and this mist will retreat on its own.
asr: Four shards are waiting for you into Mangan. Find the information that is clearly written, and this mess will retreat on its own.

text: Hold on, people of Temanggung! This lantern will shine for you!
asr: Hold on, people of Timangong, this lantern will shine for you.

text: Brrr... It's freezing, Mbah. The mist is even creeping between my fingers.
asr: Brr! It's freezing on bar. The mist is even creeping between my fingers.

text: We are on Dieng, my boy, the land above the clouds. But this is no ordinary mist. This is the heart of the Mist of Forgetting.
asr: We are on Dieang, my boy, the land above the clouds. But this is no ordinary mist. This is the heart of the mist of forgetting.

text: Mbah, listen! Someone is beating the kentongan drum. People are running around holding their phones!
asr: Bard listen, someone is beating the Contanarndrum. People are running around holding their phones.

text: They have received a chain message: "The crater will erupt tomorrow morning! Evacuate now! Share this with everyone!" There is no sender's name and no official source.
asr: They have received the chain message. The crater will erupt tomorrow morning. Evacuate now. Share this with everyone. There is no sender's name and no official source.

text: But what if the message is true, Mbah? If we do nothing, people could get hurt!
asr: But what if the message is true on bar? If we do nothing, people could get hurt.

text: That's a good question, my boy. It is exactly because this matters that we must check it. False news spreads most easily when people are afraid.
asr: That's a good question, my boy. It is exactly because this matters that we must check it. False news spreads most easily when people are afraid.

text: My boy... I cannot climb any higher. My breath is short, and these legs will not take another step.
asr: My boy, I cannot climb any higher. My breath is short and these legs will not take another step.

text: No, Mbah! I don't want to go on alone! What if I choose wrongly?
asr: No, I'm Bar. I don't want to go on alone. What if I choose wrongly?

text: I will wait for you on the shore of Telaga Warna. From there, I can see your light every time a shard returns.
asr: I will wait for you on the shore of T'Lag'u'wana. From there, I can see your light every time a shard returns.

text: I'm scared, Mbah...
asr: I'm scared, I'm bar.

text: Being scared is normal, my boy. This lantern shines because of your courage, not because you are never afraid.
asr: Being scared is normal, my boy. This lantern shines because of your courage, not because you are never afraid.

text: Listen to my advice. Before you believe, check the source. Before you share, think about what could happen. When in doubt, ask the right person.
asr: Listen to my advice. Before you believe, check the source. Before you share, think about what could happen. When in doubt, ask the right person.

text: Check the source... think about what could happen... ask the right person. I will remember, Mbah.
asr: Check the source. Think about what could happen. Ask the right person. I will remember and bar.

text: The people of Dieng don't need panic. They need the truth. And I will help them find it.
asr: People of Dieng don't need panic. They need the truth. And I will help them find it.

text: Now that's a brave child. Go, my boy. The last four shards are waiting behind the mist.
asr: Now that's a brave child. Go, my boy. The last four shards are waiting behind the mist.

text: Wait for me at Telaga Warna, Mbah. When I come back, the Lantern of Kedu will shine brighter than ever!
asr: Wait for me at Tala Gawana, Umba. When I come back, the lantern of Kudu will shine brighter than ever.

text: Long ago, surrounded by Mount Sindoro, Mount Sumbing, Mount Merapi, Mount Merbabu, and the Menoreh Hills, lay the Kedu Plain. Every night, its villages glowed with a gentle light called the Light of Kedu.
asr: Long ago, surrounded by Mount Sindoro, Mount Sumbing, Mount Morapi, Mount Mababu, and the Minore Hills lay the Kudu Plain. Every night, its villages glowed with a gentle light called the Light of Kudu.

text: That light was born from knowledge and culture: from grandparents' tales, from the reliefs of Borobudur Temple, from the songs of the farmers, and from every piece of writing read with care. It was kept inside an old lantern called the Lantern of Kedu.
asr: That light was born from knowledge and culture from grandparents' tales, from the reliefs of Borobudur Temple, from the songs of the farmers, and from every piece of riding-raid with care. It was kept inside an old lantern called the Lantern of Kudu.

text: But slowly, people began to forget. They read in a hurry, believed news without checking it, and left their ancestors' stories behind. From all that forgetting rose a cold grey mist: the Mist of Forgetting.
asr: But slowly people began to forget. They read in a hurry, believed news without checking it, and left their ancestors' stories behind, from all that forgetting rose a cold gray mist the mist of forgetting.

text: One night, the Mist of Forgetting coiled around the Lantern of Kedu. Its glass cracked, its flame trembled, and then its light shattered! Twelve Shards of Light shot into the sky and fell across Temanggung, Magelang, and Wonosobo.
asr: One night, the mist of forgetting coiled around the lantern of Kudu. Its glass cracked, its flame trembled, and then its light shattered. Twelve shards of light shot into the sky and fell across to Mangong, Magolan, and Wanosobo.

text: I am Mbah Kedu, which means Grandpa Kedu, the keeper of this lantern. My legs are too old to walk far, and each time its light fades, my body grows weaker too. I need a child who is brave and willing to read with all their heart.
asr: I am a Bakadu, which means Grand Bakadu, the keeper of this lantern. My legs are too old to walk far, and each time its light fades, my body grows weaker too. I need a child who is brave and willing to read with all their heart.

text: Let me go, Mbah! I will find all twelve shards, one by one, until the Lantern of Kedu shines again. I promise!
asr: Let me go, umber. I will find all 12 shards, one by one, until the lantern of Kudu shines again. I promise.

text: Each region holds four shards, and each shard is guarded by a challenge. Complete the challenge to win its shard and stars. Watch the lantern in the top-left corner: it grows brighter every time a shard returns.
asr: Each region holds four shards, and each shard is guarded by a challenge. Complete the challenge to win its shard and stars. Watch the lantern in the top-left corner, it grows brighter every time a shard returns.

text: Remember these three keys, my boy. In Temanggung, find the information that is clearly written. In Magelang, connect information and tell facts from opinions. In Wonosobo, judge every piece of news before you believe it.
asr: Remember these three keys, my boy. And to Maungun, find the information that is clearly written. And Ma Golan, connect information and tell facts from opinions. And Wan Ossobo, judge every piece of news before you believe it.

text: And you, explorer, will walk beside Jaka. Read carefully, think it through, and decide wisely. The Mist of Forgetting is waiting. Let us bring back the Light of Kedu!
asr: And you explorer will walk beside Jaka. Read carefully, think it through, and decide wisely. The mist of forgetting is waiting. Let us bring back the light of Kadu.

text: Magelang, my boy, is home to Borobudur Temple, the largest Buddhist temple in the world. It was built more than a thousand years ago, stone by stone, without modern machines.
asr: Ma Galaam, my boy, is home to Borobudur Temple, the largest Buddhist temple in the world. It was built more than a thousand years ago, stone by stone, without modern machines.

text: Borobudur's walls are decorated with 2,672 relief panels. Each panel is part of a story. Reading them is like reading a giant book made of stone: the order must be right for the story to make sense.
asr: Orbidur's walls are decorated with 2,672 relief panels. Each panel is part of a story. Reading them is like reading a giant book made of stone. The order must be right for the story to make sense.

text: Not far from Borobudur stand Mendut Temple and Pawon Temple. The three temples stand almost in a straight line. In the middle of the city is Mount Tidar, which folk tales call the nail of the land of Java.
asr: Not far from Borobudur, stand Mindu Temple and Paon Temple. The three temples stand almost in a straight line. In the middle of the city is Mount Tidar, which folk tales call the Nail of the Land of Java.

text: Don't miss the bold Topeng Ireng dance, with its colourful feathered headdresses. In Magelang, one piece of information is not enough. You must connect several pieces of information, then tell which are facts and which are opinions.
asr: Don't miss the bold-toping ear and dance with its colorful feathered head verses. In Magalon, one piece of information is not enough. You must connect several pieces of information, then tell which are facts and which are opinions.

text: This is Temanggung, my boy. It lies between two mountains, Sindoro and Sumbing. On a clear morning, their peaks stand side by side, like an older and a younger sibling looking after each other.
asr: This is Timangum, my boy. It lies between two mountains, Sennoro and Simbing. On a clear morning, their peaks stand side by side, like an older and a younger sibling looking after each other.

text: The soil on these mountain slopes is very fertile. Farmers grow tobacco, coffee, and vegetables. Coffee from the slopes of Sindoro and Sumbing is famous for its aroma, even far beyond the region.
asr: The soil on these mountain slopes is very fertile. Farmers grow tobacco, coffee and vegetables. Coffee from the slopes of Sendoro and soon being as famous for its aroma, even far beyond the region.

text: Temanggung also keeps traces of the past. There is the Liyangan Site, an ancient settlement once buried by material from an eruption of Mount Sindoro. There is also Pringapus Temple, and the Gondosuli Inscription, made in the year 832 CE.
asr: Tamangam also keeps traces of the past. There is the Liyanansai, an ancient settlement once buried by material from interruption of Mount Sindoro. There is also Pranapas Temple and the Gondosulyan inscription made in the year 832 CE.

text: At celebrations, people dance the jaran kepang, the hobby-horse dance, to the beat of drums and gamelan. Here you will learn to find information that is clearly stated in pictures, short texts, and sounds. The answer is often right in front of you, as long as you read carefully.
asr: At celebrations, people dance the Jaron Kapon, the hobby horse dance, to the beat of drums and gamelon. Care you will learn to find information that is clearly stated in pictures, short texts and sounds. The answer is often right in front of you as long as you read carefully.

text: Wonosobo is the gateway to the Dieng Plateau, known as the land above the clouds. It is so high up that clouds and mist often drift between people's houses.
asr: Juan Osobel is the gateway to the Dien Plateau known as the land above the clouds. It is so high up that clouds and mist often drift between people's houses.

text: On Dieng stands the Arjuna Temple complex, one of the oldest Hindu temples in Java. There is also Telaga Warna, the Lake of Colours. Its water contains sulphur, so it can look green, blue, or yellowish.
asr: On being stands the Varjuna Temple complex, one of the oldest Hindu temples in Java. There is also Telagavarna, the lake of colors. Its water contains sulfur, so it can look green, blue, or yellowish.

text: The air here is very cold. To warm up, people eat mie ongklok, noodles in a thick sauce, and enjoy sweet carica, the mountain papaya. There is also the Lengger dance and the ruwatan ceremony for children with naturally matted hair.
asr: The air here is very cold. To warm up, people eat me on clock, noodles in a thick sauce, and enjoy sweet charika, the mountain papaya. There is also the Langer Dance and the Ruaton ceremony for children with naturally matted hair.

text: This is where the Mist of Forgetting is thickest, my boy. You will come across a lot of news, and not all of it is true. Check the source, weigh the reasons, then decide wisely.
asr: This is where the mist of forgetting is thickest, my boy. You will come across a lot of news, and not all of it is true. Check the source, weigh the reasons, then decide wisely.

text: On top of the hill, Jaka lifted his lantern high. All twelve shards joined together, and a golden light poured out across the whole Kedu Plain.
asr: On top of the hill, Jorger lifted his lantern high. All twelve shards joined together, and a golden light poured out across the whole Kadu plain.

text: The Mist of Forgetting cleared from Temanggung to Magelang to Wonosobo. Signposts could be read clearly, the reliefs told their stories in the right order, and chain messages were no longer swallowed whole.
asr: The mist of forgetting cleared from Tumangung to Magalan to Wanosobo. Signposts could be read clearly. The reliefs told their stories in the right order, and chain messages were no longer swallowed whole.

text: I feel strong again, my boy! But remember, this light does not belong to the lantern alone. It lives every time someone reads with care.
asr: I feel strong again, my boy. But remember, this light does not belong to the lantern alone. It lives every time someone reads with care.

text: I will keep reading carefully, connecting information, and checking the source, Mbah. So that the Mist of Forgetting never comes back.
asr: I will keep reading carefully, connecting information and checking the source and bar, so that the mist of forgetting never comes back.

text: From today, you are the Keeper of the Lantern, my boy. And so are you, explorer. Carry this light to your school, to your home, and wherever you go.
asr: From today, you're the keeper of the lantern, my boy. And so are you, explorer. Carry this light to your school, to your home, and wherever you go.

text: This is the Kedu Plain. This valley once held the light of knowledge and culture. Now look... the Mist of Forgetting covers almost all of it.
asr: This is the Kadoo Plain. This valley once held the light of knowledge and culture. Now look, the mist of forgetting covers almost all of it.

text: I must explore three regions to bring it back: Temanggung, then Magelang, and finally Wonosobo. In each region, four Shards of Light are waiting.
asr: I must explore three regions to bring it back to Mangong, then Margalan and finally Wanosobo. In each region, four shards of light are waiting.

text: Tap the lantern icon on each region to hear Mbah Kedu's story about that place. When you are ready, tap the region whose lantern is lit. Come on, let's go!
asr: Tap the lantern icon on each region to hear Umbar Kedu's story about that place. When you are ready, tap the region whose lantern is lit. Come on, let's go!

text: Find the small bell-shaped structure full of holes. Borobudur has 72 of these on its round terraces.
asr: Find the small bell shaped structure full of holes. Or Wider has 72 of these on its round terraces.

text: Find the colourful feather headdress worn by dancers of the folk dance from Tuksongo Village, Magelang.
asr: Find the colorful feather headdress worn by dancers of the folk dance from Texongo Village, Mogulong.

text: Find the snack made of cassava that is steamed, pounded, and sweetened. This snack gave Magelang a special nickname.
asr: Find the snack made of cassava that is steamed, pounded, and sweetened. This snack gave Magalani a special nickname.

text: Find the object made of clay that is shaped and then fired, made by the people of Klipoh Hamlet.
asr: Find the object made of clay that is shaped and then fired, made by the people of Klippel Hamlet.

text: Find the woven bamboo horse used for the kuda lumping dance.
asr: Find the woven bamboo horse used for the cuta lumping dance.

text: Find the coffee beans that grow on the slopes of Mount Sindoro and Mount Sumbing.
asr: Find the coffee beans that grow on the slopes of Mount Zindoro and Mount Tsumbi.

text: Find the statue of Nandi the bull, like the one inside Pringapus Temple.
asr: Find the statue of Nani the Bull, like the one inside Pringapas Temple.

text: Find the uceng fish, a small river fish that is a special food of Temanggung.
asr: Find the Uching Fish, a small river fish that is a special food of Timangan.

text: Find the musical instrument shaped like a curved hood of woven bamboo. The hood once protected duck herders from the sun and rain, and then strings were added to pluck.
asr: Find the musical instrument shaped like a curved hood of woven bamboo. The hood once protected duck herders from the sun and rain, and then strings were added to pluck.

text: Find the mountain fruit that looks like a papaya but is small. It grows well in cool air and is often made into sweets.
asr: Find the mountain fruit that looks like a papaya but is small. It grows well in cool air and is often made into sweets.

text: Find the small bamboo basket that is dipped again and again into boiling water. Its name was used to name Wonosobo's special noodles.
asr: Find the small bamboo basket that is dipped again and again into boiling water. Its name was used to name one of Sobo's special noodles.

text: Find the leaves that are brewed into a warm drink. They are picked at the Tambi estate, which has existed since 1865.
asr: Find the leaves that are brewed into a warm drink. They are picked at the Tambay estate, which has existed since 1865.

text: Listen, my boy... Those two men have stopped arguing. Now they are reading the reliefs together, from beginning to end.
asr: Listen, my boy, those two men have stopped arguing. Now they are reading the reliefs together, from beginning to end.

text: And Mbah... you can stand up straight again!
asr: And in bar, you can stand up straight again.

text: Eight shards have returned, and my strength is coming back. The Magelang Library is now open to you.
asr: HRs have returned and my strength is coming back. The Mogulon Library is now open to you.

text: Only one region left. Wonosobo, here we come!
asr: Only one region left. Wanna Sobo, here we come.

text: Look, my boy! The mist over Temanggung has parted. The signposts can be read again, and people have found their way home.
asr: Look, my boy, the mess over to Mongun has parted. The samples can be read again and people have found their way home.

text: Four shards are back in the lantern! It feels so warm, Mbah.
asr: Four shards are back in the lantern. Feels so warm, umbar.

text: That is the reward for your care. The Temanggung Library is now open to you. Read as much as you like.
asr: That is the reward for your care. The Tamangan Library is now open to you. Read as much as you like.

text: Thank you, Mbah. Now, on to Magelang!
asr: Thank you, Ombar. Now, on to Margalang.

text: Mbah! I did it! People asked the officials about the message. The crater is safe, and nobody needs to evacuate!
asr: Mbar, I did it. People asked the officials about the message. The crater is safe and nobody needs to evacuate.

text: I saw it from the lake shore, my boy. Every time you chose wisely, the mist on that peak grew a little thinner.
asr: I saw it from the lake shore, my boy. Every time you chose wisely, the mist on that peak grew a little thinner.

text: Twelve shards... every single one is back!
asr: 12 shards. Every single one is back.

text: The Wonosobo Library is open to you. Now, let's go home and light the Lantern of Kedu together.
asr: The Wanosobo Library is open to you. Now, let's go home and light the lantern of Kadu together.

text: Mbah, lihat lenteraku! Serpihan dari Temanggung sudah menyala di dalamnya. Magelang pasti lebih mudah!
asr: Embahal lihat keantera aku, serpian dari temanggung sudah menyala di galannya, makhlang pasti lebih mudah.

text: Jangan cepat merasa hebat, Le. Kabut di Magelang punya tipu daya yang lain.
asr: Jangan cepat merosah heta-dela. Kabut di Magelang punya tipu daya yang lain.

text: Tipu daya apa, Mbah? Itu Candi Borobudur, kan? Megah sekali... Tapi kenapa relief-reliefnya tampak aneh?
asr: Tipu daya apalemah itu candi baru budura kan? Megah sekali, tapi kenapa relief reliefnya tanpa anak?

text: Kabut Lupa mengacak urutannya. Awal cerita ada di akhir, akhir cerita ada di tengah. Siapa pun yang membacanya sekarang hanya mendapat potongan-potongan yang membingungkan.
asr: Kabut lupa mengacak urutannya. Awal cerita ada di akhir-akhir cerita ada di tengah. Siapapun yang membacanya sekarang hanya mendapat potongan-potongan yang membingungkan.

text: Mbah, dengar... Di bawah sana ada dua bapak yang sedang bertengkar.
asr: Embahed dengar, di bawah sana ada dua bapak yang sedang bertengkar.

text: Yang satu berteriak, "Katanya candi ini dibangun dalam satu malam!" Yang lain membalas, "Katanya semua itu cuma dongeng!" Keduanya bersuara keras, tapi tak seorang pun mau memeriksa.
asr: Yang satu berteriakok katanya candi ini dibamun dalam satu malam. Yang lain membalas ke katanya semua itu cuma dongeng. Kedua nya bersuara kerasa tapi tak seorang pun mau memeriksa.

text: Jadi, mana yang benar, Mbah?
asr: Jadi mana yang benar embah?

text: Itulah tugasmu, Le. Pendapat boleh berbeda, tapi fakta bisa dibuktikan. Hubungkan informasi yang satu dengan yang lain, maka kebenaran akan terlihat.
asr: Titulat Tugas Muleh, pendapat boleh berbeda tapi fata bisa dibuktikan, hubungkan informasi yang satu dengan yang lain mau pokok benaran akan terlihat.

text: Uhh... Maaf, Le. Kaki Mbah gemetar. Setiap kali kabut menebal, tenaga Mbah seperti ikut tersedot.
asr: Wah, maafle, K.I.Embah gemetara, setiap kali kabut menepalit tenaga Embah seperti ikut tersedot.

text: Mbah! Mbah tidak apa-apa? Tangan Mbah dingin sekali!
asr: Embah,embah tidak apa-apa, tangan embah dingin sekali.

text: Tenang... Mbah hanya perlu duduk sebentar. Cahaya lentera dan tubuh tua ini saling terikat, Le. Semakin banyak serpihan kembali, semakin kuat Mbah.
asr: Tanah, bahana perlu duduk sebentar. Cahaya lantirah dan tubuh tua ini saling terikatlah. Semakin banyak serpahan kembali semakin kuat, embah.

text: Kalau begitu, Mbah istirahat saja di sini. Biar aku yang menyusun cerita-cerita itu kembali.
asr: kalau begitu embah istirahat saja di sini biar aku yang menyusun cerita-cerita itu kembali.

text: Kamu sudah berbeda dari anak yang dulu berlari ke papan petunjuk tanpa membacanya.
asr: Kamu sudah berbeda dari anak yang dulu berlari ke papan petunjuk tanpa membadanya.

text: Karena aku belajar dari Mbah. Baca dengan teliti dulu, baru bertindak!
asr: Karena aku belajar dari Embah, bacah dengan taliti dulu baru pertindak.

text: Ingat pesan Mbah: temukan ide pokoknya, susun urutannya, dan pisahkan fakta dari pendapat. Empat serpihan Magelang menunggumu.
asr: Ingat pesan embah temukan ide pokoknya susun urutannya dan pisahkan fato dari pendapat. Empat serpihan mage lang menunggu mu.

text: Aku berangkat, Mbah. Sebelum senja, relief-relief itu akan bercerita dengan benar lagi!
asr: Taku berangkat teenbah, sebelum Senjarelius-Relius itu akan bercerita dengan Benar Lagit.

text: Kita sudah sampai, Le. Temanggung... Dulu, dari bukit ini, lampu-lampu desa tampak seperti bintang yang jatuh ke ladang. Sekarang lihatlah. Semuanya kelabu.
asr: Kita sudah sampai lah, temanggunga. Dulu dari bukit ini lampu-lampu di sol tampak seperti pintang yang jatuh ke ladang. Sekarang lihatlah, semuanya kelabu.

text: Kabutnya tebal sekali, Mbah. Aku hampir tidak bisa melihat jalan setapak di depan kita.
asr: Kabutnya tebal sekali, Enbah. Aku hampir tidak bisa melihat jalan setapak di depan kita.

text: Kabut Lupa turun ke sini lebih dulu. Dengar itu? Warga saling memanggil di tengah ladang. Mereka tersesat di kampung mereka sendiri.
asr: Kabut lupa turun ke Simi lebih dulu. Dengar itu, warga saling memanggil di tengah ladang. Mereka tersesat di kampung mereka sendiri.

text: Tersesat? Bagaimana bisa, Mbah? Bukankah di setiap persimpangan ada papan petunjuk?
asr: Tersesata bagaimana bisa lembah? Bukankah di setiap persimpangan ada papan petunjukkop?

text: Ada. Tapi kabut membuat tulisannya samar. Orang hanya melirik sekilas, lalu menebak arah. Satu tebakan keliru, dan mereka berputar-putar di ladang sampai senja.
asr: Adah, tapi kabut membuat tulisannya samar. Porang hanya melirik segila selalu menepak arah. Satu tebakan keliru dan merek berputar-putar di ladang sampai senjail.

text: Kalau begitu kita harus cepat, Mbah! Aku langsung cari serpihannya saja. Pasti ada yang bersinar di balik kabut!
asr: Kalau begitu kita harus cepat TNB, aku langsung cari serpihannya saja. Pasti ada yang bersinar di balik kabut.

text: Lihat, ada papan petunjuk! Panahnya ke kanan... Ayo, Mbah, lewat sini!
asr: ni hagal adah papan petunjukkoh panahnya ke kanana payo kembah lewat sini

text: Tunggu, Le! Berhenti! Jangan hanya melihat panahnya. Baca dulu seluruh tulisannya.
asr: Tunggu le, behentia, jangan hanya melihat panahnya. Baca dulu seluruh tulisannya.

text: "Jembatan rusak. Silakan lewat kiri." Aduh... Kalau tadi aku berlari ke kanan, kita bisa terperosok ke sungai.
asr: cembatan dusak, silakan lewat kiri. Taduh, kalau tadi aku berlari ke kanan kita bisa terperosok ke sumait.

text: Nah. Mata yang terburu-buru melewatkan jawaban yang tertulis jelas. Kabut Lupa paling senang pada anak yang tidak sabar.
asr: Nah, mata yang terburu-buru meliwakan jawaban yang tertulis jelas. Kabut lupa paling senang pada anak yang tidak sabar.

text: Maaf, Mbah. Aku cuma ingin cepat-cepat menolong semua orang.
asr: Maaf, Embah, aku cuma ingin cepat-cepat menolong semua orang.

text: Niatmu baik, Le. Tapi menolong juga butuh ketelitian. Lihat, begitu kamu membaca dengan benar, kabut di papan itu menipis. Di balik bukit, serpihan cahaya pertama mulai berkilau.
asr: Miatmu baik gula, tapi menolong juga butuh kedelitian. Lihatlah begitu kamu membaca dengan benar kaput dipapan itu menitis. Di balik bukit serpihan cahaya pertama mulai berkilau.

text: Aku mengerti sekarang. Aku akan membaca kata demi kata, melihat gambar dengan saksama, dan mendengarkan baik-baik.
asr: Aku mengerti sekarang, aku akan membaca kata demi kata melihat gambar dengan saksama dan mendengarkan baik-baik.

text: Empat serpihan menunggumu di Temanggung. Temukan informasi yang tertulis jelas, maka kabut ini akan mundur dengan sendirinya.
asr: 4 serpihan menunggu mudi temang bunga. Temukan informasi yang tertulis jelas sama kokabut ini akan mundur dengan sendirinya.

text: Tunggu kami, warga Temanggung! Lentera ini akan menyala untuk kalian!
asr: Tunggu kami warga temanggung. Lenterah ini akan menyala untuk kalian.

text: Brrr... Dingin sekali, Mbah. Kabutnya sampai masuk ke sela-sela jariku.
asr: Berah, dingin sekali, Enbah. Kabutnya sampai masuk ke selah-selah jari ku.

text: Kita di Dieng, Le, negeri di atas awan. Tapi kabut ini bukan kabut biasa. Di sinilah jantung Kabut Lupa.
asr: Kita didinglengeri di atas awan, tapi kabut ini bukan kabut biasa. Di sini lah jantung kabut lupa.

text: Mbah, dengar! Ada kentongan dipukul. Orang-orang berlarian sambil memegang ponsel!
asr: Kembahai dengar, adah kentongan dibukuloh, orang-orang berlarian sambil memegang ponsel.

text: Mereka menerima pesan berantai: "Kawah akan meledak besok pagi! Cepat mengungsi! Sebarkan ke semua orang!" Tak ada nama pengirim, tak ada sumber resmi.
asr: Mereka menerima pesan berantai kawah akan meledak bisok pagi. Cepat mengumsik, seberkankah semua orang. Tak ada nama pengirimu, tak ada sumber rosmi.

text: Tapi bagaimana kalau pesan itu benar, Mbah? Kalau kita diam saja, orang bisa celaka!
asr: Tapi bagaimana kalau pesan itu benar embah kalau kita dian saja orang bisod celaka?

text: Pertanyaan yang bagus, Le. Justru karena ini penting, kita harus memeriksanya. Kabar bohong paling mudah menyebar ketika orang sedang takut.
asr: Pertanyaan yang bagus ole, Justru Karena ini penting kita harus memerek sayap, kabar bohong paling mudah menyebar ketika orang sedang takut.

text: Le... Mbah tidak kuat naik lebih tinggi lagi. Napas Mbah pendek, dan kaki ini sudah tidak mau melangkah.
asr: Lah, Mbah tidak kuat naik lebih timbilah jid. Napas Mbah pendek dan kati ini sudah tidak mau melangkah.

text: Tidak, Mbah! Aku tidak mau berjalan sendirian! Bagaimana kalau aku salah memilih?
asr: tidak, embah, aku tidak mau berjalan sendirian bagaimana kalau aku salah menilih?

text: Mbah akan menunggumu di tepi Telaga Warna. Dari sana, Mbah bisa melihat cahayamu setiap kali satu serpihan kembali.
asr: Mbah akan menunggumu di tepi telaga warna. Dari sana Mbah bisa melihat cahayamu setiap kali satu serpian kembali.

text: Aku takut, Mbah...
asr: Aku takut tuh, Enbah.

text: Takut itu wajar, Le. Lentera ini menyala karena keberanianmu, bukan karena kamu tidak pernah takut.
asr: Takut itu wajar leh. Lenterah ini menyala karena keberanian mau bukaan karena kamu tidak pernah takut.

text: Dengarkan pesan Mbah. Sebelum percaya, periksa sumbernya. Sebelum membagikan, pikirkan akibatnya. Kalau ragu, tanyakan kepada orang yang tepat.
asr: Dengarkan pesan embah, sebelum percaya beriksas umurnya, sebelum membagikanu pitirkan adibatnya, kalau ragu tanahkan kepada orang yang tepat.

text: Periksa sumbernya... pikirkan akibatnya... tanyakan kepada orang yang tepat. Aku akan mengingatnya, Mbah.
asr: Periksa sumbernya, pikirkan atibatnya, tanyakan kepada orang yang tepat, aku akan meningkatnya embah.

text: Warga Dieng tidak butuh kepanikan. Mereka butuh kabar yang benar. Dan aku akan membantu mereka menemukannya.
asr: wargo yang tidak butuh kepanikan mereka butuh kabar yang benar dan aku akan membantu mereka menemukannya

text: Itu baru anak pemberani. Pergilah, Le. Empat serpihan terakhir menunggu di balik kabut.
asr: Titu baru anak pemberani ya. Pergilah lah. Empat serpihan terakhir menunggu di balik kaput.

text: Tunggu aku di Telaga Warna, Mbah. Saat aku kembali, Lentera Kedu akan menyala paling terang!
asr: Tunggu aku di telaga warna embah. Saat aku kembali lentera keduakan menyalao paling terang.

text: Dahulu kala, di antara Gunung Sindoro, Sumbing, Merapi, Merbabu, dan Perbukitan Menoreh, terbentang Dataran Kedu. Setiap malam, desa-desanya diterangi cahaya lembut yang disebut Cahaya Kedu.
asr: Dau lu kalahal diantara gunung sindoro sumbingu, merapi, merbabut dan perbukitan menorehe terbentang dataran kedu. Setiap malam, desa-disanya diterangi cahaya lembut yang disebut cahaya kedu.

text: Cahaya itu lahir dari ilmu dan budaya: dari dongeng para kakek dan nenek, dari relief Candi Borobudur, dari tembang para petani, dan dari setiap tulisan yang dibaca dengan teliti. Cahaya itu disimpan di dalam sebuah lentera tua bernama Lentera Kedu.
asr: Cahayah itu lahir dari ilmu dan budaya dari dongeng parah kakek dan nenekul dari Relyas, kandiburu budhurud dari tembang parah petaniye dan dari setiap tulisan yang dibacau dengan teliti. Cahayah itu disimpan di dalam sebuah lenterah tuah bernama lenterah kedud.

text: Namun perlahan, orang-orang mulai lupa. Mereka membaca dengan terburu-buru, memercayai kabar tanpa memeriksanya, dan meninggalkan cerita para leluhur. Dari kelupaan itu, naiklah kabut kelabu yang dingin: Kabut Lupa.
asr: Namun perlahan orang-orang mulai lupa, mereka membakar dengan terburu-buru, memercayai kabar tanpa memeriksanya dan meninggalkan cerita parah leluhur dari kelupaan itu naiklah kabut kelabu yang dingin kabut lupa.

text: Pada suatu malam, Kabut Lupa membelit Lentera Kedu. Kacanya retak, apinya bergetar, lalu cahayanya pecah! Dua belas Serpihan Cahaya melesat ke langit dan jatuh di Temanggung, Magelang, dan Wonosobo.
asr: Pada suatu malam, kabut lupo membilit lenterah kedut. Kacanya retako apinya bergetarelalu cahayanya pacah. 12 serpihan cahayah, meresak ke langit dan jatuh di temanggungu Magelangu dan Wono Sobo.

text: Aku Mbah Kedu, penjaga lentera ini. Kakiku sudah terlalu tua untuk berjalan jauh, dan setiap kali cahayanya meredup, tubuhku ikut melemah. Aku butuh anak yang berani dan mau membaca dengan sungguh-sungguh.
asr: Aku embah kedua penjaga lentera ini. Kahiku sudah terlalu tua untuk berjalan jauh dan setiap kali cahaya nyomere duku-duku ikut melemah. Aku butuh anak yang berani dan mau membaca dengan sungguh-sungguh.

text: Biar aku yang pergi, Mbah! Aku akan mencari kedua belas serpihan itu satu per satu, sampai Lentera Kedu menyala lagi. Aku janji!
asr: biar aku yang pergi embah, aku akan mencari ke 12 serbihan itu satu per satu sampai lentera ke du menyala lagi. Kaku janjir.

text: Setiap wilayah menyimpan empat serpihan, dan setiap serpihan dijaga oleh satu tantangan. Selesaikan tantangannya untuk mendapatkan serpihan dan bintang. Lihat lentera di pojok kiri atas: lentera itu makin terang setiap kali serpihan kembali.
asr: Setiap wilayah menyimpan empat serpihanu dan setiap serpihan dijogo oleh satu tantangan. Selesaikan tantangannya untuk mendapatkan serpihan dan bintang. Lihat lenterah di pojok kiri atas lenterah itu makin terang setiap kali serpihan kembali.

text: Ingat tiga kunci ini, Le. Di Temanggung, temukan informasi yang tertulis jelas. Di Magelang, hubungkan informasi dan bedakan fakta dari pendapat. Di Wonosobo, nilailah setiap kabar sebelum kamu memercayainya.
asr: Timat 3 kunci ini, Le. Di temanggungu temukan informasi yang tertulis jelas. Di maglang menghubungkan informasi dan bedaan fakta dari pendapat. Diwono sobo nilai lah setiap kabar sebelum kamu memercayainya.

text: Dan kamu, penjelajah, akan berjalan bersama Jaka. Bacalah dengan teliti, pikirkan baik-baik, dan putuskan dengan bijak. Kabut Lupa sudah menunggu. Mari nyalakan kembali Cahaya Kedu!
asr: dan kamu penjelajahat akan berjalan bersama jaka. Bacalah dengan teliti pikirkan baik taiko dan putuskan dengan bijak. Kabut lupo sudah menunggu. Mari nyalakan kembali cahaya kedu.

text: Magelang, Le, adalah rumah Candi Borobudur, candi Buddha terbesar di dunia. Candi itu dibangun lebih dari seribu tahun lalu, batu demi batu, tanpa mesin modern.
asr: Magelang Le'a adalah rumah Tandi Borobudurit Tandi Buddha terbesar di dunia. Tandi itu dibuang lebih dari seibu tahun lalu batu demi batu tanpa mesin modern.

text: Dinding Borobudur dihiasi 2.672 panel relief. Setiap panel adalah bagian dari sebuah cerita. Membacanya seperti membaca buku raksasa dari batu: urutannya harus benar supaya ceritanya utuh.
asr: Dinding Borobudur dihyasi 2672 panel ralih. Setiap panel adalah bagian dari sebuah cerita. Membakannya seperti membaca buku raksasa dari batu urutannya harus benar supaya ceritanya utuh.

text: Tak jauh dari Borobudur ada Candi Mendut dan Candi Pawon. Ketiganya berdiri hampir segaris. Di tengah kota ada Gunung Tidar, yang dalam cerita rakyat dijuluki paku tanah Jawa.
asr: Tak jauh dari Borobudur adah candi mendot dan candi pawon, ketidaknya berdiri hampir segaris, di tengah kota adah kunung Tidaro yang dalam cerita rakyat di juluki Pakutana Jawa.

text: Jangan lewatkan tari Topeng Ireng yang gagah, dengan hiasan kepala berbulu warna-warni. Di Magelang, satu informasi saja tidak cukup. Kamu harus menghubungkan beberapa informasi, lalu membedakan mana fakta dan mana pendapat.
asr: Jangan lewakan tari topeng irong yang gagah dengan hiasan kepala berbulu warna warni. Di Magelangos satu informasi saja tidak cukup. Kamu harus menghubungkan beberapa informasi lalu membedaan manah fakta dan manah pendapat.

text: Inilah Temanggung, Le. Tanahnya diapit dua gunung, Sindoro dan Sumbing. Kalau pagi cerah, kedua puncaknya tampak berdiri berdampingan, seperti kakak dan adik yang saling menjaga.
asr: Timilah temang gongelah. Tanahnya diapet dua gunungus Indoro dan Sumbin. Kalau pagi cerah kedua pun cadna tampak berdiri berdampingan seperti kakak dan adik yang saling menjaga.

text: Tanah di lereng gunung ini sangat subur. Para petani menanam tembakau, kopi, dan sayuran. Kopi dari lereng Sindoro dan Sumbing terkenal harum sampai ke luar daerah.
asr: Tanah di lering gunung ini sangat subuh. Parah petani menanam tembakau kopi dan sayuran, kopi dari lering sindoro dan sumbing terkenal harum sampai ke luar daerah.

text: Temanggung juga menyimpan jejak masa lalu. Ada Situs Liyangan, permukiman kuno yang pernah tertimbun material letusan Gunung Sindoro. Ada pula Candi Pringapus, dan Prasasti Gondosuli yang dibuat pada tahun 832 Masehi.
asr: Temanggung juga menyimpan jijak masa lalu. Ada situs wiangana permukiman kuno yang pernah tertimbun material letusan kunung Sindoro. Ada hulokan di ringapusit dan prasastik gondosuli yang dibuat pada tahun 832 Maseid.

text: Saat ada perayaan, warga menari jaran kepang diiringi kendang dan gamelan. Di sini kamu akan belajar menemukan informasi yang tertulis jelas dari gambar, teks pendek, dan suara. Jawabannya sering ada di depan mata, asal kamu membacanya dengan teliti.
asr: Saat adah paraya Anwargo menari jaran kepang diri nih kendang dan gamelan. Di sini kamu a-an belajar menemukan informasi yang tertulis jelas dari gambaruteks pendek dan suara. Jawabannya sering adah di depan mata, asal kamu membacanya dengan teliti.

text: Wonosobo adalah pintu menuju Dataran Tinggi Dieng, yang dijuluki negeri di atas awan. Letaknya sangat tinggi, sampai-sampai awan dan kabut sering lewat di antara rumah penduduk.
asr: Wono Sopo adalah pintu menuju dataran tinggi diengyang dijuluki negeri di atas awan. Letaknya sangat tinggi sampai-sampai awan dan kaput sering lewat di antara rumah penduduk.

text: Di Dieng berdiri kompleks Candi Arjuna, salah satu candi Hindu tertua di Jawa. Ada juga Telaga Warna. Airnya mengandung belerang, sehingga warnanya bisa tampak hijau, biru, atau kekuningan.
asr: Diding berdiri kompleks candi Arjunal salah satu candi hindu tertua di Jawa. Adah juga telah gawarna. Ternya mengandung belerangus sehingga warnanya bisa tampak hijau biru atau kekuningan.

text: Udara di sini dingin sekali. Untuk menghangatkan badan, warga menyantap mi ongklok yang berkuah kental, lalu menikmati manisan carica, si pepaya gunung. Ada pula tari Lengger dan tradisi ruwatan anak berambut gimbal.
asr: Bebdaro disini dingin sekali. Untuk mengangakan badannya wargo menyantap Mi Ongklo yang berkuah kentalelalu menikmati manisan tarijal si Pebaya Gunung. Ada pulau tarilingir dan tradisi ruatan anak Brahmud Gimbal.

text: Di sinilah Kabut Lupa paling tebal, Le. Kamu akan menemukan banyak kabar, dan tidak semuanya benar. Periksa sumbernya, timbang alasannya, lalu putuskan dengan bijak.
asr: Di sini lah kabut lupa paling tebal lah. Kamu akan menemukan banyak kabar dan tidak semuanya benar. Periksa sumbernya timbang alasannya lalu putuskan dengan dijab.

text: Di puncak bukit, Jaka mengangkat lenteranya tinggi-tinggi. Kedua belas serpihan menyatu, dan cahaya keemasan memancar ke seluruh Dataran Kedu.
asr: Dipunca Bukit Tijoko mengangkat planterannya tinggi-tinggi. Kedua belas serpihan menyatu dan cahayah kemasan memancar ke seluruh dataran kedua.

text: Kabut Lupa tersibak dari Temanggung, Magelang, sampai Wonosobo. Papan petunjuk terbaca jelas, relief bercerita dengan urutan yang benar, dan pesan berantai tak lagi ditelan mentah-mentah.
asr: Kabut, lupa tersebut dari temanggunga Magelangge sampai Wonozobo. Papat petunjuk terbajak jelasur Elias bercerita dengan urutan yang benar dan pesan berantai tak lagi ditelan mentah mentah.

text: Badan Mbah terasa segar lagi, Le! Tapi ingat, cahaya ini bukan hanya milik lentera. Cahaya ini hidup setiap kali seseorang membaca dengan teliti.
asr: Badan embah terasa segar lagi, leh. Tapi ingat, cahaya ini bukan hanya milik lentera. Cahaya ini hidup setiap kali seorang membaca dengan teliti.

text: Aku akan terus membaca dengan teliti, menghubungkan informasi, dan memeriksa sumbernya, Mbah. Supaya Kabut Lupa tidak pernah kembali.
asr: Aku akan terus menbaca dengan telitil, menghubungkan informasi redan memriksa sumbernya alkembah supaya kabut luput tidak pernah kembali.

text: Mulai hari ini, kamulah Penjaga Lentera, Le. Kamu juga, penjelajah. Bawalah cahaya ini ke sekolahmu, ke rumahmu, dan ke mana pun kamu pergi.
asr: Mulai hari ini ya kamu lah penjaga lentera, ole. Kamu juga penjaja. Bawalah cahaya ini ke sekolahmu, ke rumahmu, dan kemanapun kamu pergi.

text: Inilah Dataran Kedu. Dulu lembah ini menyimpan cahaya ilmu dan budaya. Sekarang lihatlah... Kabut Lupa menutupi hampir semuanya.
asr: Tindilah dataran kedudh. Dulu lembah ini menyimpan cahaya ilmu dan budaya. Sekarang lihatlah, kabut lupa menutupi hampir semuanya.

text: Aku harus menjelajahi tiga wilayah untuk memulihkannya: Temanggung, lalu Magelang, dan terakhir Wonosobo. Di setiap wilayah, empat Serpihan Cahaya sedang menunggu.
asr: Aku harus menjelajahi tiga wilayah untuk memulikannya temanggungu lalu Magelangu dan terakhir Wono Sobo. Di setiap wilayah empat carpihan cahaya sedang menunggu.

text: Ketuk ikon lentera di setiap wilayah untuk mendengar cerita Mbah Kedu tentang tempat itu. Kalau sudah siap, ketuk wilayah yang lenteranya menyala. Ayo, kita berangkat!
asr: Ketok ikon lenterah di setiap wilayah untuk mendengar cerita embah kedu tentang tempat itu. Kalau sudah siapa ketok wilayah yang lenterahnya menyala, tayo kita berangkatah.

text: Temukan bangunan kecil berbentuk lonceng yang berlubang-lubang. Di teras bundar Borobudur ada 72 bangunan seperti ini.
asr: Temuan bangunan kecil berbentuk lonceng yang berlubang-lubang. Di tras Bundar Borobudur Adah 72 bangunan seperti ini.

text: Temukan hiasan kepala dari bulu warna-warni yang dipakai penari tari rakyat dari Desa Tuksongo, Magelang.
asr: Temukan hiasan kepala dari bulu warna-warni yang dipakai penari tarir rakyat dari desa Tuxong Womaglang.

text: Temukan jajanan dari singkong yang dikukus, ditumbuk, lalu diberi gula. Jajanan ini membuat Magelang punya julukan khusus.
asr: Temukan jajanan dari singkong yang di kukusut ditumbuk lalu di berigula. Jajanan ini membuat magelang punya juluhan khusus.

text: Temukan benda dari tanah liat yang dibentuk lalu dibakar, buatan warga Dusun Klipoh.
asr: Temukan benda dari tanah liat yang dibentuk lalu dibakaruh buatan Wargotuson Gripoh.

text: Temukan kuda-kudaan dari anyaman bambu yang dipakai untuk menari kuda lumping.
asr: Temukan kuda-kudaan dari anyaman bambu yang dipakai untuk menarik kuda lumping.

text: Temukan biji kopi yang tumbuh di lereng Gunung Sindoro dan Sumbing.
asr: Temukan biji kopi yang tumbuh di lering gunung Sindoro dan Sumin.

text: Temukan arca lembu Nandi, seperti yang ada di dalam Candi Pringapus.
asr: Temukan arco lembunan dia seperti yang ada di dalam candi Pringapus.

text: Temukan ikan uceng, ikan sungai kecil yang menjadi makanan khas Temanggung.
asr: Temukan ikan uceng ikan sungai kecil yang menjadi makanan khas pemanggungu.

text: Temukan alat musik berbentuk tudung lengkung dari anyaman bambu. Dulu tudung itu melindungi penggembala bebek dari panas dan hujan, lalu diberi senar untuk dipetik.
asr: Temuan alat musik berbentuk tudung lengkung dari anggaman bambu. Dulu, tudung itu melindungi pengembalo bebek dari panas dan hujanel lalu diperisenar untuk dibetih.

text: Temukan buah pegunungan yang mirip pepaya, tetapi ukurannya kecil. Buah ini tumbuh baik di udara sejuk dan sering dibuat manisan.
asr: Temukan buah pegunungan yang mirip pepaya tetapi ukurannya kecil. Buah ini tumbuh baik di udara sejuk dan sering dibuat manisan.

text: Temukan keranjang bambu kecil yang dicelup-celupkan ke air mendidih. Nama alat ini dipakai untuk menamai mi khas Wonosobo.
asr: Temukan keranjang bambu kecil yang dicelok-celokkan ke air mendidih. Nama alat ini dipakai untuk menamai mihaswanosobok.

text: Temukan daun yang diseduh menjadi minuman hangat. Daun ini dipetik di perkebunan Tambi yang sudah ada sejak tahun 1865.
asr: Temukan daun yang diseduh menjadi minuman hangat. Daun ini dipetik di perkebunan tambi yang sudah ada sejak tahun 1865.

text: Dengar, Le... Kedua bapak itu berhenti bertengkar. Sekarang mereka membaca relief bersama-sama, dari awal sampai akhir.
asr: Denarlah, kedua Bapak itu berhenti bertengkah. Sekarang mereka membaca relief bersama-sama dari awal sampai akhir.

text: Dan Mbah... Mbah sudah bisa berdiri tegak lagi!
asr: dan emah, emah sudah bisa berdiri teka lagi.

text: Delapan serpihan sudah kembali, dan tenaga Mbah ikut pulih. Pustaka Magelang kini terbuka untukmu.
asr: Dilapan serpahan sudah kembali dan tenaga embah ikut pulih. Pusta kaumak gelang kini terbuka untukmu.

text: Tinggal satu wilayah lagi. Wonosobo, kami datang!
asr: Tinggal satu wilayah lagi, wono sobo kanidatang.

text: Lihat, Le! Kabut di Temanggung tersibak. Papan petunjuk bisa dibaca lagi, dan warga sudah menemukan jalan pulang.
asr: Lihatlah, kaput ditemanggung tersiba. Papat petunjuk disodibacol lagi dan warga sudah menemukan jalan pulang.

text: Empat serpihan sudah kembali ke lentera! Rasanya hangat sekali, Mbah.
asr: Empat serpihan sudah kembali ke lendera. Rasanya hana sekali, Enbah.

text: Itu buah ketelitianmu. Pustaka Temanggung kini terbuka untukmu. Bacalah sepuasnya.
asr: Itu buah kekelitian muk, pustaka temanggung gimi terbuka untuk muk. Bacalah sepuasnya.

text: Terima kasih, Mbah. Sekarang, ke Magelang!
asr: Terima kasih, embah. Sekarang kema kelang.

text: Mbah! Aku berhasil! Warga sudah menanyakan kabar itu kepada petugas resmi. Kawahnya aman, tidak ada yang perlu mengungsi!
asr: kembal, aku berhasil. Puarga sudah menanyakan kabar itu kepada petugas resmit. Kawahnya aman tidak ada yang perlu mengungsih.

text: Mbah melihatnya dari tepi telaga, Le. Setiap kali kamu memilih dengan bijak, kabut di puncak itu menipis sedikit demi sedikit.
asr: Mbah melihatnya dari tepi telah galah. Setiap kali kamu memilih dengan bijaku kabut di punca itu menipis sedikit demi sedikit.

text: Dua belas serpihan... semuanya sudah kembali!
asr: 12 pihana. Semuanya sudah kembali.

text: Pustaka Wonosobo terbuka untukmu. Sekarang, mari kita pulang dan nyalakan Lentera Kedu bersama-sama.
asr: Pusta Kowonosobu terbuka untukmu. Sekarang omari kita pulang dan nyalatan nentera kedu bersama-sama.
